summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, advertising, or monetization. Recommendation: keep private, preview-only, and do not send rights outreach until human counsel reviews the upstream rights and owner authorizes outreach. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms restrict the proposed commercial/public uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, privacy, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains CONDITIONAL when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closed because direct evidence is still missing. Progress: official API, terms, and support review completed; repository/configuration data-flow artifacts, privacy policy, cookie policy, and draft terms are partially evidenced. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel before any owner-authorized outreach or launch decision.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is BLOCKED; missing written permission or an API agreement and field-level limits for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is EVIDENCE_NEEDED; the measurement-only purpose and consent-gated processing are conditionally supportable, but deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional treatment are missing. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; operational use is conditionally supportable, but log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident handling, subpoena handling, and data-subject-request procedures are missing. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request inventory. No secondary disclosure or monetization is cleared.

Fleet compliance and data-quality disposition: CONDITIONAL for ordinary reversible growth; not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry. The technical compliance baseline reports 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings; this is not legal certification. Analytics quality is yellow because at least one GA4/GSC source is unavailable or permission-limited. Revenue is partial aggregate: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, with the commission in an unattributed aggregate row. Do not treat unavailable telemetry as zero or make ROI, margin, forecast, or causal-lift claims. Continue only existing evidence, repair-or-close, measurement, and reconciliation work.

Private and parked properties require a concrete decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence; escalate incomplete packets to CTO at the existing deadline.
